question: By default, how long does Kubernetes give a Pod to terminate gracefully?
gold_span: A Pod is granted a term to terminate gracefully, which defaults to 30 seconds.

question: What is the default port range Kubernetes allocates NodePort Services from?
gold_span: --service-node-port-range flag (default: 30000-32767)

question: What is the maximum size of the data stored in a ConfigMap?
gold_span: ConfigMap cannot exceed 1 MiB

question: How many old ReplicaSets does a Deployment keep for rollback by default?
gold_span: The rest will be garbage-collected in the background. By default, it is 10.

question: What is the default backoffLimit of a Kubernetes Job?
gold_span: The .spec.backoffLimit is set by default to 6

question: How often does the kubelet run a liveness probe if periodSeconds is not set?
gold_span: How often (in seconds) to perform the probe. Default to 10 seconds.

question: How many consecutive probe failures does Kubernetes need before it considers the check failed, by default?
gold_span: Defaults to 3. Minimum value is 1. For the case of a startup or liveness probe

question: How many successful finished Jobs does a CronJob keep by default?
gold_span: This field specifies the number of successful finished jobs to keep. The default value is 3.

question: What is the maximum length of the name segment of a label key?
gold_span: must be 63 characters or less, beginning and ending with an alphanumeric

question: What is the default maxSurge of a Deployment rolling update?
gold_span: at most 125% of the desired number of Pods are up (25% max surge)

question: If I omit imagePullPolicy and the image has a tag that is not :latest, what pull policy does the Pod get?
gold_span: image that isn't :latest, the imagePullPolicy is automatically set to IfNotPresent

question: If I omit imagePullPolicy and don't specify any tag for the image, what pull policy is set?
gold_span: you don't specify the tag for the container image, imagePullPolicy is automatically set to Always

question: When a Pod's restartPolicy is Always, what restart policy do its init containers use?
gold_span: if the Pod restartPolicy is set to Always, the init containers use restartPolicy OnFailure

question: If a StorageClass is created without a reclaimPolicy, what reclaim policy do its dynamically provisioned volumes get?
gold_span: If no reclaimPolicy is specified when a StorageClass object is created, it will default to Delete.

question: With the Retain reclaim policy, can a new claim use the PersistentVolume right after its PersistentVolumeClaim is deleted?
gold_span: But it is not yet available for another claim because the previous claimant's data remains on the volume.

question: With the OnDelete update strategy, when are new DaemonSet pods created after I update the template?
gold_span: new DaemonSet pods will only be created when you manually delete old DaemonSet pods

question: When a Deployment uses the Recreate strategy, what happens to the existing Pods during an update?
gold_span: All existing Pods are killed before new ones are created when .spec.strategy.type==Recreate.

question: For a LoadBalancer Service, which externalTrafficPolicy value preserves the client source IP?
gold_span: Local preserves the client source IP and avoids a second hop

question: How many failed finished Jobs does a CronJob keep by default?
gold_span: This field specifies the number of failed finished jobs to keep. The default value is 1.

question: When backoffLimitPerIndex is specified on an Indexed Job, what does .spec.backoffLimit default to?
gold_span: then .spec.backoffLimit defaults to 2147483647 (MaxInt32).

question: What kubectl command do I run to safely drain a node before maintenance when it runs DaemonSet pods?
gold_span: kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets <node name>

question: How do I roll a DaemonSet back to a specific earlier revision?
gold_span: kubectl rollout undo daemonset <daemonset-name> --to-revision=<revision>

question: How do I mark the current default StorageClass as non-default?
gold_span: {"metadata": {"annotations":{"storageclass.kubernetes.io/is-default-class":"false"}}}

question: How do I create a Secret so Pods can pull images from a private registry with a username and password?
gold_span: kubectl create secret docker-registry regcred --docker-server=<your-registry-server>

question: Which command lists the container images of all Pods in all namespaces?
gold_span: kubectl get pods --all-namespaces -o jsonpath="{.items[*].spec['initContainers', 'containers'][*].image}"

question: How do I take a snapshot backup of etcd?
gold_span: etcdctl --endpoints $ENDPOINT snapshot save snapshot.db

question: How do I forward a local port to a port on a Pod with kubectl?
gold_span: kubectl port-forward mongo-75f59d57f4-4nd6q 28015:27017

question: How do I watch the progress of a Deployment rolling update?
gold_span: kubectl rollout status deployment/nginx-deployment

question: After draining a node for maintenance, how do I let Kubernetes schedule Pods on it again?
gold_span: kubectl uncordon <node name>

question: How do I add a label to a node so I can schedule a Pod onto it with nodeSelector?
gold_span: kubectl label nodes <your-node-name> disktype=ssd
